recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, full-body silhouette of a male figure standing against a vibrant, circular yellow-to-orange sunburst. The background features a horizontal sunset gradient over a dark, indistinct ground. Bold, blocky text is layered both above and directly over the silhouette, utilizing high-contrast color fills.
coreVisualRelationships: The silhouette acts as a central vertical axis, bisecting the circular light source.
The primary title text is layered over the silhouette, creating a stencil-like interaction between figure and letterform.
The top text anchors the upper margin, balancing the visual weight of the central figure.
The color transition from bright yellow center to dark brown edges creates a vignette effect that focuses the viewer's eye on the subject.
coreInvariants: Backlit silhouette of a single figure
Horizontal horizon line in the lower third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The figure is centered horizontally, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow circular glow behind the figure's torso and head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright center, move up to the top header, then down through the layered text on the body to the dark base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, warm-toned gradients on the left and right margins provide breathing room for the central high-contrast elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep brown and burnt orange provide the atmospheric background and silhouette fill.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant yellow serves as the primary light source and highlight for the top text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright orange-to-yellow gradients within the central text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the center sunburst with a rapid falloff into low-value, dark tones at the edges.

letterConstructionRules: Minimal kerning for a compact, block-like appearance
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters over the silhouette are filled with the background gradient to create a 'see-through' effect.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display face paired with a light, tracked-out secondary sans-serif for contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary blocky, condensed impact for the display text.
Classic urban feel with strong legibility.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic sunset background with a central bright yellow sunburst fading into dark orange and brown. Place a solid black silhouette of a man standing in the center, facing forward, from the knees up. The ground should be a dark, flat plane.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, condensed uppercase sans-serif text at the top in bright yellow. Add a three-line title in the center, layered directly over the silhouette's chest and torso, using a gradient fill that matches the bright yellow of the sunburst behind the figure.

verificationChecks: Is the central text legible against the silhouette?
Is the sunburst centered behind the figure?
Is the color palette strictly warm (yellow, orange, brown)?
Is the typography heavy and condensed?

mustRedesign: Avoid specific artist names or brand logos
Ensure the silhouette is a generic figure
Do not replicate specific mixtape series identifiers
postGenerationChecks: Check for color banding in the background gradient.
Ensure the silhouette edges are sharp and not blurry.
Verify the text is perfectly centered.
Confirm the 'see-through' effect on the central text is convincing.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central Silhouette + Radial Sunburst + Heavy Condensed Typography + Warm Gradient Palette
